windows.title: PMetal - Apple Silicon ML Training Suite
windows.label: main

security.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.longDescription: PMetal is a native Apple Silicon ML training suite. Features LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning, GRPO/DPO/DAPO reinforcement learning, knowledge distillation, model merging, GGUF quantization, and real-time inference with Metal GPU acceleration.
